tool_config.description: Look up one cow on the farm and open her card on the farmer's screen. Call it whenever the farmer names or describes a cow: an ear tag like "0613" (any number they say), a name, or a description like "the one limping". The cow returned is the one in the calving pen right now; her card shows the live calving-pen camera with her ID. Returns JSON { found, cow:{id,name,breed,age_years,parity,group,status,dim,last_calving,expected_calving,repro,lameness_score,series_14d:{milk_kg,rumination_min,activity_idx,temp_c,feed_visits},events,calving:{stage,next,startedMinAgo,camera,pen}}, candidates }. Never state cow facts without calling this first.
tool_config.name: find_cow

query.description: Ear tag digits exactly as the farmer said them (e.g. "0613" or "613"), a cow name, or a description such as "the one limping".
